name: Fossacesia (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fossacesia (a chevron and a star on white) within branches, with the inscription CITTÀ DI FOSSACESIA in yellow arched beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Fossacesia, a comune in Abruzzo; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Fossacesia arms — chevron and star on white, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI FOSSACESIA arched beneath the arms
